findings.message: evals/runner.py:1707-1708 — evaluate() returns {"check": "G-02", "passed": False} for an empty dict or a non-dict payload. It never checks the agent's out.schema.json. G-02 is the harness's schema grader, and the harness runs it before evaluate (component instructions). So evaluate() reports a schema failure that no schema produced. The register says an empty object is valid only when the schema accepts it, and the recorded gap says the case schema names no field. Remove the fabricated G-02 decision. evaluate() should only perform the G-05 judge step, or should not decide at all when the payload cannot be judged.

evals/runner.py:1730-1731 — verdict() drops any result with passed True before it looks at the threshold row. A row whose threshold value is blank therefore counts as a silent pass and appears in no list. The docstring says the opposite: 'A blank threshold is an incomplete specification, not a pass'. eval-compilation rule 3 and the register require a blank threshold to be reported as unvalidated. All 13 rows have values today, so this is latent. Route a result against a blank-threshold row to 'recorded' (or 'findings') whatever passed says.

evals/runner.py:1730-1735 — eval-compilation rule 7 says a threshold that is not numeric can only be monitor, and its achieved value is reported without pass or fail. verdict() checks for a non-numeric threshold only after it has skipped passed results. A non-numeric row that 'passed' is therefore never recorded, and it is still graded pass/fail. Do the non-numeric check before the passed check, and always put such a result in 'recorded'.

evals/runner.py:1736-1741 — any tier_at_rung other than 'blocking' or 'advisory' falls through to 'recorded'. That includes a blank value or a typo such as 'Blocking'. A malformed tier is silently treated as monitor and cannot fail the gate. The instructions name only the values monitor, advisory and blocking. An unknown or blank tier is an incomplete specification and should be surfaced, not downgraded to monitor in silence.

evals/runner.py:4 — the module docstring cites 'Precord 7382e6e9'. That identifier is not in the C4 context, which gives revision 64b79111… and c3_revision 621277f…. Cite a source that can be traced (provenance-discipline), or drop the hash.

Known gap (recorded C4-1 / EVAL_NO_TEST_CASES). All 120 CASES are split dev, so scored_cases() returns [] and the runner decides no acceptance. The runner handles this correctly by not scoring dev cases. C4 stays degraded until the Precord supplies test-split cases. Carry this as a promotion blocker.
